home.headline: Hey. My name is João — JVK around here.
paragraphs: This website is where I keep things I've built, ideas I tried to turn into something real, projects that worked, others that are still evolving, and tools I've learned along the way.
A lot of what you see here started because I didn't know how to build something and decided to learn until I could make the idea work.
You'll find systems, interfaces, data, maps, automation, experiments, and a few ideas that will probably change a lot over time.
Some things are finished. Others aren't. This website is still evolving too.

legal.title: Portfolio Notes
paragraphs: This website brings together projects, studies, experiments and demonstrations developed throughout my work and learning.

Some demonstrations were rebuilt specifically for public presentation, preserving the idea and technical decisions without using personal, administrative or contextual information that does not belong in the portfolio.
When data appears in a public demonstration, it is fictional and exists only to allow exploration of the features.
Some projects continue evolving and may change over time.
